# Accordion

A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

- **Import:** `import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/data-display-accordion--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import {
  Accordion,
  AccordionContent,
  AccordionItem,
  AccordionTrigger,
  ThemeProvider,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function AccordionExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Accordion type="single" collapsible className="w-full">
        <AccordionItem value="item-1">
          <AccordionTrigger>Is it accessible?</AccordionTrigger>
          <AccordionContent>
            Yes. It adheres to the WAI-ARIA design pattern.
          </AccordionContent>
        </AccordionItem>
        <AccordionItem value="item-2">
          <AccordionTrigger>Is it styled?</AccordionTrigger>
          <AccordionContent>
            Yes. It comes with default styles that matches the other
            components&apos; aesthetic.
          </AccordionContent>
        </AccordionItem>
        <AccordionItem value="item-3">
          <AccordionTrigger>Is it animated?</AccordionTrigger>
          <AccordionContent>
            Yes. It&apos;s animated by default, but you can disable it if you
            prefer.
          </AccordionContent>
        </AccordionItem>
      </Accordion>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Accordion

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `AccordionRootProps`, which is `AccordionProps & (AccordionPrimitive.AccordionSingleProps | AccordionPrimitive.AccordionMultipleProps)`.

- `variant`: `"default" | "boxed"`, optional.

  How the sections are drawn. Defaults to "default", rows divided by a rule.
  "boxed" (decision 149) draws each header as a box of its own, 8 apart: a
  hairline while closed, and filled with theme 900 while open, with the
  section's content in the page's flow under it. Its height is the
  density's control height: 40 compact, 44 touch.

- `type`: `'single' | 'multiple'`, **required**.

  `'single'` in `AccordionPrimitive.AccordionSingleProps`; `'multiple'` in `AccordionPrimitive.AccordionMultipleProps`.

- `value`: `string | string[]`, optional.

  `string` in `AccordionPrimitive.AccordionSingleProps`; `string[]` in `AccordionPrimitive.AccordionMultipleProps`.

  In `AccordionPrimitive.AccordionSingleProps`: The controlled stateful value of the accordion item whose content is expanded.

  In `AccordionPrimitive.AccordionMultipleProps`: The controlled stateful value of the accordion items whose contents are expanded.

- `defaultValue`: `string | string[]`, optional.

  `string` in `AccordionPrimitive.AccordionSingleProps`; `string[]` in `AccordionPrimitive.AccordionMultipleProps`.

  In `AccordionPrimitive.AccordionSingleProps`: The value of the item whose content is expanded when the accordion is initially rendered. Use
  `defaultValue` if you do not need to control the state of an accordion.

  In `AccordionPrimitive.AccordionMultipleProps`: The value of the items whose contents are expanded when the accordion is initially rendered. Use
  `defaultValue` if you do not need to control the state of an accordion.

- `onValueChange`: `((value: string) => void) | ((value: string[]) => void)`, optional.

  `(value: string) => void` in `AccordionPrimitive.AccordionSingleProps`; `(value: string[]) => void` in `AccordionPrimitive.AccordionMultipleProps`.

  The callback that fires when the state of the accordion changes.

- `collapsible`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.

  Only in `AccordionPrimitive.AccordionSingleProps`.

  Whether an accordion item can be collapsed after it has been opened.

- `disabled`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.

  Whether or not an accordion is disabled from user interaction.

- `orientation`: `React.AriaAttributes['aria-orientation']`, optional, default `vertical`.

  The layout in which the Accordion operates.

- `dir`: `Direction`, optional.

  The language read direction.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## AccordionItem

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `Omit<AccordionPrimitive.AccordionItemProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "ref">`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `disabled`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.

  Whether or not an accordion item is disabled from user interaction.

- `value`: `string`, **required**.

  A string value for the accordion item. All items within an accordion should use a unique value.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## AccordionTrigger

It forwards its ref to `HTMLButtonElement`. Its props are `AccordionTriggerProps`, which extends `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof AccordionPrimitive.Trigger>`.

- `icon`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.

  The boxed form's mark at the start, drawn 20 square.

- `label`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.

  The boxed form's small line over the title, and the product's words:
  "Step 1/5". Read before the title, as part of the trigger's name.

- `loading`: `boolean`, optional.

  A spinner where the chevron is, and the trigger busy to assistive
  technology and disabled while it is set, in either form. The section's
  content is left alone, and `disabled` here can't turn it off.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## AccordionContent

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `Omit<AccordionPrimitive.AccordionContentProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "ref">`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `forceMount`: `true`, optional.

  Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when
  controlling animation with React animation libraries.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
